description: This Dart source file defines an API client class `ApiClient` that wraps the Dio HTTP client for network requests. It manages JWT token attachment, supports retries, and includes a circuit breaker pattern for resiliency. The class provides a method `getJson` for fetching JSON data from a specified path with automatic handling of tokens, retries, and circuit breaking.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A network client for making authenticated and resilient HTTP requests, specifically designed to handle JSON responses, token management, retries, and circuit breaking.

methods.name: getJson
methods.description: Makes a GET request to the specified path, attempts to retrieve a JSON object, with automatic retries and circuit breaker protection.
